title: FreightCar America, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Exceptional Order Intake and Increasing Market Share Drive Sequential Backlog Growth of 121% Aftermarket Revenue Growth of 13% Year over Year; Second Aftermarket Acquisition Completed Following Quarter End Operating Cash Flow of $12.1 Million and Free Cash Flow of $11.3 Million, Up 43% Year over Year CHICAGO, Aug. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FreightCar America, Inc. (NASDAQ: RAIL) (“FreightCar America” or the “Company”), a diversified manufacturer and supplier of railroad freight cars, railcar parts and components, today reported results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. Second Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenues of $113.1 million, compared to $118.6 million in the second quarter of 2025, with railcar deliveries of 927 units compared to 939 units in the prior year period Aftermarket revenues grew 13% year over year, reflecting continued organic growth in parts and components and the contribution from our recent acquisition Gross margin of 5.5% with gross profit of $6.2
